transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because most days I wake up already feeling weighed down, like there’s this gray heaviness on me. Even when I’m at work with the crew or around my kids, I can’t really shake it. I just feel low and kind of hollow, like I’m going through the motions.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It’s been about three years now… a little over that, maybe three years and three months. It started after the groundskeeping contract changed and our schedule got longer. Since then, it’s just kind of taken over my life.
Do you find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I mean, I know I don’t feel like myself most of the time, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s about pleasure exactly.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?
I’m not sure, honestly. I know I don’t feel right most days, but I haven’t really thought about whether I still enjoy things the way I used to. It’s hard for me to tell.
Do you still find joy or interest in hobbies or activities that you previously enjoyed?
I guess I don’t really know. I haven’t been paying close attention to whether it’s joy or interest exactly. I just know most things don’t feel the same, but I can’t give you a clear answer on that.
Are there things you used to enjoy doing that you no longer enjoy?
I don’t know that I can point to anything specific. I just haven’t really been keeping track like that. Things feel kind of flat, but I’m not sure I’d say I no longer enjoy certain things.
Can you think of anything that you still look forward to or get excited about?
I’m not sure. Nothing really comes to mind right away. I don’t notice myself getting excited about much, but I also haven’t really been thinking of it that way.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?
I don’t know if I’d put it that way exactly. I mean, things don’t grab me like they used to, but I haven’t really sat down and thought, “I don’t care about this anymore.” I’m just not sure.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities or things that would normally bring you happiness?
I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I’m completely unable to feel pleasure, but I don’t notice much that makes me happy either. It’s more like things just don’t do much for me, I guess.
Do you feel like things that used to make you happy no longer bring you any happiness?

I don’t know that I can say they bring me no happiness at all. It’s more like… if something used to make me feel good, now it just feels kind of flat. I might still do it, but I’m not really getting much from it.
Do you feel like you're unable to enjoy things that most people would find enjoyable?

I’m not sure. I mean, I can’t really speak for what most people enjoy. I just know for me, a lot of things feel kind of dull or not worth the effort. But I don’t know if I’d say I’m completely unable to enjoy them.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that normally would bring you happiness?
I don’t really know how to answer that any different. I wouldn’t say I can’t feel pleasure at all… it’s just not much. Things that should make me happy mostly feel pretty muted.
Do you feel like you've lost the ability to feel pleasure in things that you used to enjoy?
I’m not sure I’d say I’ve lost the ability completely. It’s more like the enjoyment is barely there now. I can still do some of the things I used to like, but they don’t really hit the same.
Do you feel tired or have low energy most of the time?

Yeah. Most days I’m tired pretty early. Like by midmorning, my body already feels like I’ve worked a full day. Even if I sleep in on Sunday, I still drag through basic stuff—loading tools, looking over job plans, making dinner. It all feels heavier than it should.
Have you had any periods in the past three years where you felt completely back to normal for at least a couple of months?

No, not really. I can’t think of a stretch where I felt back to normal for a couple months. This has been going on about three years and a few months now, since our groundskeeping contract changed and the longer days kind of took over my life.
Do you feel like you can't enjoy things that you used to find pleasurable?
I guess I’m not sure how to answer that any differently. I still can do some things, but the enjoyment isn’t really there like it used to be. It’s kind of muted.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that normally would bring you happiness?
I’m not sure I’d say completely unable. It’s more like things don’t hit the same. Something might be okay for a little bit, but I don’t really feel happy from it the way I think I should.
Has this low mood you're describing been present for two years or more?
Yes. It’s been more than two years. I’d say about three years and three months now, since that groundskeeping contract changed our schedule and the longer days took over my life.
Have you had any periods in the past three years where you felt completely back to normal for at least two months?

No, not really. It’s been pretty steady the whole time, about three years and three months since that contract change and the longer workdays started. I don’t remember any two-month stretch where I felt back to normal.
Is your low mood present for most of the day, every day?

Yeah… most days, pretty much from when I wake up, it’s there. It feels like this gray weight on me, and even if I’m working with the crew or around my kids, I can’t really shake it. I’m just kind of going through the motions most of the day.
